editorial:
You settle in for what feels like a normal movie date, but Michael and his date quickly find themselves running from a zombie attack that turns the night into pure panic. The vibe is playful at first, then creepy, with big dance moves, sharp costumes, and a spooky story that keeps you grinning even when things get scary. It feels like a mini movie wrapped inside one of the most famous music videos ever made, so every scene has a fun, larger-than-life energy.

The acting is simple but charming, the pacing never drags, and the dance scenes are the real showstopper. The only downside is that it is short, so you may wish there were more story. Still, if you enjoy horror, music, or pop culture history, this is a blast.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Michael turns into a zombie and joins the undead crowd, chasing his date through the streets. Just when you think she is trapped, she wakes up and realizes it was all a nightmare. Then Michael looks at you with glowing yellow eyes and laughs, leaving you wondering if the horror is really over. It is a fun twist that turns the whole video into a spooky joke.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves pop culture, horror, and dance.
